query: Does the World Bank Pink Sheet (CMO Historical Data Monthly Excel file) contain a 'Sulphur (Tampa)' price series in USD/metric ton, as of mid-2026? Inspect the actual column headers in the official CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx fertilizer group (Phosphate rock, DAP, TSP, Urea, Potassium chloride) to confirm whether a Sulphur/Sulfur column exists. If the series exists, what are its reported monthly values for Jan-Jun 2026?
answer:
## Summary

**The World Bank Pink Sheet (CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx) does NOT contain a "Sulphur (Tampa)" price series** — and does not contain any sulphur/sulfur series at all — as of mid-2026.

**Confirmed fertilizer group (exactly 5 columns, all in USD/metric ton):**
| Series | Definition |
|---|---|
| DAP | diammonium phosphate, spot, f.o.b. US Gulf |
| Phosphate rock | f.o.b. North Africa |
| Potassium chloride | muriate of potash, granular spot, CFR Brazil |
| TSP | triple superphosphate, spot, import US Gulf |
| Urea (E. Europe) | prill spot, f.o.b. Middle East |

I verified this against the official World Bank Pink Sheet PDFs (June/April/February 2026), which share the identical column headers, units, and footnote definitions as the xlsx "Monthly Prices" tab, plus multiple third-party mirrors of the WB fertilizer dataset. **There is no sixth row for sulphur.**

**Key clarification:** "Sulphur (Tampa)" is a genuine industry benchmark (molten sulfur, Tampa FL), but it's published by trade sources like Argus/CRU/Green Markets — **not** by the World Bank. Sulfur appears in WB materials only as narrative discussion (April 2026 Commodity Markets Outlook) and a standalone 1984 technical paper, never as a Pink Sheet price series.

**Consequently, there are no Jan–Jun 2026 sulphur values to report** because the column doesn't exist. For context, I did capture the actual fertilizer monthly values (e.g., DAP rose from $619.2/mt in Jan 2026 to $769.5/mt in May 2026; the overall fertilizer index then fell 21.8% m/m in June 2026 per the July 2026 release).

Latest data vintage: **July 2026 Pink Sheet release (published July 2, 2026)**, covering data through June 2026.

key_facts: The World Bank Pink Sheet CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx does NOT contain a 'Sulphur (Tampa)' or any sulphur/sulfur price series as of mid-2026.
The Fertilizers group contains exactly five series: DAP, Phosphate rock, Potassium chloride, TSP, and Urea (E. Europe), all in USD/metric ton.

Fertilizer definitions: DAP spot f.o.b. US Gulf; Phosphate rock f.o.b. North Africa; Potassium chloride (muriate of potash) granular spot CFR Brazil; TSP spot import US Gulf; Urea (E. Europe) prill spot f.o.b. Middle East.
'Sulphur (Tampa)' is a real industry benchmark published by Argus/CRU/Green Markets, but it is NOT a World Bank Pink Sheet series.

Sulfur appears in World Bank materials only as narrative discussion (April 2026 Commodity Markets Outlook) and in a standalone 1984 World Bank 'World Sulphur Survey' technical paper — not as a monthly price series.
Latest data vintage: July 2026 Pink Sheet release published July 2, 2026, covering data through June 2026.
Current xlsx download URL uses document node 74e8be41ceb20fa0da750cda2f6b9e4e-0050012026.
World Bank reported the overall fertilizer price index fell 21.8% month-on-month in June 2026.
There are no Jan-Jun 2026 sulphur monthly values because no sulphur column exists in the file.
